newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Apr-Jan exchequer receipts 122.1 bln rand.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Apr-Jan exchequer receipts 122.1 bln rand.

text.p: Total exchequer receipts in the first ten months of the 1996/97 (April-March) financial year were 122.061 billion rand -- an increase of 14.6 percent compared to 1995, the Finance Department said on Friday.
During April to January 1997, 82.8 percent of the revised revenue estimate of 147.4 billion rand was received.

During January 1997 financing of 2.62 billion rand was obtained in government bonds, while short term loans (net) increased by 727.7 million rand, bringing the total financing for January 1997 to 3.344 billion rand.
Government bonds and debentures amounting to 15.096 billion rand and foreign loans to the amount of 750 million rand were redeemed during April to January 1997.
The overall Exchequer balance on January 31 was 2.596 billion rand. If the balance in the Tax and Loans Accounts was included, the figure amounted to 10.183 billion rand, the department said.
